problem: The note calls the a in 'ma-' a 字首 (prefix/word-initial), but material starts with m and has no prefix 'a'; misleading term.

fix.n: er 後接母音，在此唸 /ɪr/（同 here）；ma 的 a 不重讀，弱化成 /ə/

problem: '字首 o' is wrong: pollution starts with p, the reduced o is inside the first syllable 'pol', not a prefix.

fix.n: -tion 唸 /ʃən/；pol 的 o 不重讀，弱化成 /ə/

problem: '字首 o' is wrong: solution starts with s, the reduced o is in the first syllable 'so', not a prefix.

fix.n: -tion 唸 /ʃən/；重讀 u 唸長音 /u/；so 的 o 弱化成 /ə/

problem: '字首 a' is wrong: career starts with c, the reduced a is in the first syllable 'ca', not a prefix.

fix.n: eer 唸 /ɪr/；ca 的 a 不重讀，弱化成 /ə/

problem: '字首 a' is wrong: traditional starts with t, the reduced a is in the first syllable 'tra', not a prefix.

fix.n: -tion 唸 /ʃən/；tra 的 a 不重讀，弱化成 /ə/

problem: Labels -league as an exception, but it is regular (ea /i/, final gue with silent ue, exactly like 'league'); stressed o is not mentioned.

fix.n: 重讀 o 在閉音節唸 /ɑ/；ea 唸 /i/，字尾 ue 不發音（同 league）

problem: '字首 dis 弱讀 /dɪ/' tells the learner the letters dis sound /dɪ/, i.e. that s is silent; the s is pronounced and joins the next syllable (/dɪˈspleɪ/).

fix.n: ay 唸長音 /eɪ/；字首 dis 不重讀唸 /dɪs/，s 和後面的 pl 連讀

problem: '字首 dis 弱讀 /dɪ/' implies a silent s; the s is pronounced and joins the next syllable (/dɪˈstɝb/).

fix.n: ur 唸 /ɝ/；字首 dis 不重讀唸 /dɪs/，s 和後面的 t 連讀
